_: Better End, from All of Fabric 3's census (W4 R6, judged 2026-11-11). Named one by one, only the blocks that census saw as ground and judged, because any word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Their paths, bricks, tiles, pillars, pedestals, slabs, stairs and walls were not judged and are left to the rules.

End: the mosses, chorus nylium, end mycelium, rutiscus, sangnum and shadow grass are the living surface of the End's own ground, as nylium is the Nether's and BYG's phyliums are the End's; flavolite, violecite, sulphuric rock, brimstone and the three jadestones are natural rock found only as the End's ground, as BYG's purpur stone was judged. All are rock to the game, which the rules leave out for having no stone word, and detection gave brimstone and the jadestones stone by the stone in their names.
Sand: end stone dust is loose fine grains, sand wherever it lies, and the rules leave it out for the stone in its name.

Stone: mossy obsidian is natural obsidian with moss on it, solid rock as vanilla obsidian is, and the rules leave it out for its decorative word; this census did not judge it, and it is named as 1.20.1's file and the 26.x files have it, so the editions match (W4 R14, 2026-11-13).

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.16.5 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
